'''Dimitris Koukoulopoulos''' (born 1984) is a Greek [[mathematician]] working in [[analytic number theory]] as a professor at the [[University of Montreal]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Koukoulopoulos, Dimitris, 1984- - LC Linked Data Service: Authorities and Vocabularies {{!}} Library of Congress, from LC Linked Data Service: Authorities and Vocabularies (Library of Congress) |url=https://id.loc.gov/authorities/names/no2019113968.html |access-date=12 July 2022 |website=Library of Congress}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Dimitris Koukoulopoulos |url=https://dms.umontreal.ca/~koukoulo/ |website=homepage at University of Montreal}}</ref>

In 2019, in joint work with [[James Maynard (mathematician)|James Maynard]], he proved the [[Duffin-Schaeffer conjecture]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal |last1=Koukoulopoulos |first1=Dimitris |last2=Maynard |first2=James |date=2020 |title=On the Duffin-Schaeffer conjecture |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/10.4007/annals.2020.192.1.5 |journal=Annals of Mathematics |volume=192 |issue=1 |pages=251 |arxiv=1907.04593 |doi=10.4007/annals.2020.192.1.5 |jstor=10.4007/annals.2020.192.1.5 |s2cid=195874052}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Hartnett |first=Kevin |date=2019-08-14 |title=New Proof Settles How to Approximate Numbers Like Pi |url=https://www.quantamagazine.org/new-proof-settles-how-to-approximate-numbers-like-pi-20190814/ |access-date=2022-01-16 |website=Quanta Magazine |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2019-08-11 |title=Greek Mathematician Solves 78-Year-Old Riddle |url=https://greekreporter.com/2019/08/11/greek-mathematician-solves-78-year-old-riddle/ |access-date=2022-01-17 |website=GreekReporter.com |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Sloman |first=Leila |title=New Proof Solves 80-Year-Old Irrational Number Problem |url=https://www.scientificamerican.com/article/new-proof-solves-80-year-old-irrational-number-problem/ |access-date=2022-01-17 |website=Scientific American |language=en}}</ref>

He was an invited speaker at the 2022 [[International Congress of Mathematicians]].<ref>{{cite web |title=ICM Number Theory and Geometry in Zurich |url=https://people.math.ethz.ch/~zerbess/index_ICM.html}}</ref>

He was the 2022 recipient of the [[Ribenboim Prize]] of the Canadian Number Theory Association.<ref>{{cite web | last=Cesari | first=Marion | title=2022 Ribenboim Prize Awarded to Dimitris Koukoulopoulos | website=Site officiel du Centre de recherches mathématiques (CRM) | date=2024-06-20 | url=https://www.crmath.ca/en/2024/06/20/2022-ribenboim-prize-awarded-to-dimitris-koukoulopoulos/ | access-date=2025-11-01}}</ref>
